items.question: Which additional floral and vegetal materials are prescribed as suitable ritual offerings?
premises: Madana flowers are included among the prescribed offering materials.
Sindhuvāra flowers are included among the prescribed offering materials.
Very tender durvā grass sprouts are included among the prescribed offering materials.
items.inference: The ritual prescription extends to madana flowers, sindhuvāra flowers, and very tender durvā grass sprouts as acceptable offerings.
uncertainties: The exact botanical identification of madana and sindhuvāra may vary by tradition.
items.plain_english: And with madana flowers, sindhuvāra flowers, and very tender sprouts of durvā grass.
